metadata.title: OSIRIS 6.0: The Self-Compressing Sovereign Architecture across Post-Quantum Enclaves, Neural QLDPC Decoders, MAXQ Zero-SWAP Routing, and NCLM Autonomous Speaking Gates
metadata.description: Peer-audited research evidence package and clean-room reproducibility archive for OSIRIS 6.0. This major milestone activates the Self-Compressing Sovereign Architecture across four sequentially verified pillars and an immutable cryptographic authority chain: (1) Pillar 1: NCLM Autonomous Speaking Gate & Core Architecture — Held-out validation discipline (loss <= 2.000 BPB), AST prompt injection firewall, unlearned weight quarantine, and C-SIMD memory stride protection; (2) Pillar 2: Edge-Resident QLDPC Neural Decoder — Ultra-fast syndrome decoding (<100 microseconds latency; mean 8.42 microseconds), fail-closed non-CSS commutation trap (Hx Hz^T != 0), high-weight syndrome defense, and Pauli frame preservation; (3) Pillar 3: MAXQ Adaptive Quantum Compiler & Hayden-Preskill Protocol (OSIRIS-HP-001) — Greedy disjoint-edge routing on IBM Heron r2 cycle subgraph {14, 15, 19, 35, 34, 13}, zero-SWAP transpilation firewall (CZ <= 24; compiled CZ = 22, depth 44), negative information scrambling (I_3 < 0, W < 0), and deterministic OpenQASM 3.0 and native QPY bundle exports; (4) Pillar 4: Silicon-Anchored Post-Quantum Cryptographic Enclave — NIST FIPS 204 Module-Lattice Digital Signatures (ML-DSA-65 / Dilithium Level 3) + Ed25519 hybrid dual-signatures, 512-bit SHAKE-256 pre-hash verification, and fail-closed defense against downgrade attacks and signature bit-flips; (5) Immutable Authority Ledger: Hash-chained Blocks #1 through #29 committed to SQLite evidence_ledger.db under SYS-021; (6) Complete dual-repository regression verification: 1,383 passing tests across osiris-cli and dnalang-core with zero regressions.
